dogecoin.text: People have been trying to short @elonmusk for years... ask someone who took a long short on @Tesla how that’s working out for them. Now Hedge Funds are shorting Dogecoin.. some people never learn. @elonmusk has our backs.
If #dogecoin is .50 and you buy now, it goes to 1.00 later this year and you buy a Tesla with it... that’s a 50% discount...
Buy #dogecoin if you want a discount on a Tesla later? Sounds like a good deal to me....
